notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Dryad Arbor.
description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Tireless Provisioner twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Dryad Arbor.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
